data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Fourthstone's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in ISTR and AVBH.

ISTR reported Q2 2026 total interest income of $53.2M versus $35.4M a year earlier, up 50.5% year over year (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1602658/000143774926026348/0001437749-26-026348-index.htm).

I can send the free weekly issue and offer a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
